question: Who is qualified to worship the kṛtyā according to the prescribed rule?
premises: The kṛtyā is to be worshipped.
Worship must follow the prescribed rule.
The worshipper is the best knower of the mantra.
inference: The best knower of the mantra should worship the kṛtyā according to rule.
plain_english: The best knower of the mantra should worship the kṛtyā according to the prescribed rule.
